commit_message: fix: apply promotional discount to order total
explanation: This commit introduced the discount feature into order_total. It correctly computes the discount amount (e.g. 10% of $110 = $11.00), but the final return expression uses `base + discount` instead of `base - discount`. This means the discount is added to the subtotal rather than deducted, producing $121.00 instead of the correct $99.00. The inline comment in the committed code even acknowledges the mistake: '# Regression: discount is added instead of subtracted.'
